title: Art. Cards. Community.
subtitle: Burrito at NFT NYC ’26
imageAlt: Nygilia’s Night Walker Paradox 004 displayed on a screen at Lume Studios
credit: Nygilia — Night Walker Paradox 004. Event image shared by Burrito.
summary: A gallery gathering with a different kind of opening act: our first MTG draft, with card packs made by Burrito artists.
body: We brought art to the walls and artists to the table. At Lume during NFT NYC ’26, a group exhibition met our first Magic: The Gathering draft, with custom card packs featuring work from the collective.
The exhibition included Nygilia’s Night Walker Paradox 004 and work by Desultor. The draft gave people another way to spend time with art—and with each other.
Thank you to collect.rip for sponsoring the event, and Tanarchy for documenting the draft.

title: Dérailler
subtitle: Sydney’s underground in Paris
imageAlt: Dérailler poster showing two people greeting each other near the Eiffel Tower
credit: Dérailler event poster · shared by Burrito.
summary: A book, a film, eleven street photographers, and an afternoon that spilled into the city.
body: Our first event outside the US brought Burrito to Le Grand Jeu in Paris for Dérailler: Sydney’s Underground in Paris.

The afternoon brought together Jet Williams’s debut novel Off the Rails, the first screening of a film by Max Dona connected to its world, and an exhibition of eleven street photographers curated by Burrito.
We closed with a collective photo walk. Each person could take seven photographs, choose one, and vote on their favorite. Jet gave the winner a camera and ten rolls of film.
The exhibition grew from an open call for black-and-white work exploring street photography and graffiti. Submissions for this show are closed.

gallery.alt: A second view of the Dérailler event in Paris

title: Return to Form
subtitle: A group drop, together in a room
imageAlt: MP’s safehouse displayed on a gallery screen at Return to Form
credit: MP — safehouse. Installation image shared by Burrito.
summary: More than twenty artists. A collective release on Rarible. A night at Lume to see it together.
body: Return to Form brought more than twenty artists’ approaches to a shared theme into one collective release, then off the screen and into Lume Studios.
The collection was live on Rarible by November 12, with the gallery event following on November 15. Artists also joined a conversation on X Spaces about the work.
Made with support from Rarible, Shape, Manifold, and the RARI Foundation community.

title: Super Burrito 366
subtitle: A year of looking, shared in New York
summary: Selections from the collective’s daily curation with Joyn, exhibited with SuperchiefNFT at The Canvas.
body: Burrito partnered with SuperchiefNFT to bring selections from its January and February curations to The Canvas in New York. The exhibition drew on a project of daily curation with Joyn.
This entry preserves the year and details recorded in the original Burrito archive.

title: Intertwined
subtitle: Connections, made visible
summary: Artists gathering around the connections between their work, their communities, and Miami.
body: Intertwined brought artists from different backgrounds together in Miami to share their stories through art. A gathering about the threads between people and the city around them.

title: Burrito & the Bean
subtitle: Art meets ETH Chicago
summary: A meeting of local creativity and the wider collective during ETH Chicago.
body: Burrito & the Bean brought artists together during ETH Chicago, making space for different practices and local perspectives to meet an engaged audience.

title: Burrito Bazaar
subtitle: A night at Lume
summary: A New York gathering of artists and their work at Lume Studios.
body: The Burrito Bazaar brought the collective to Lume Studios in New York for an exhibition and a night together. A place to discover work, meet its makers, and keep the conversation going.

title: Art on Tap
subtitle: Burrito at ETH Denver
summary: Art, conversation, and community at Enigma Bazaar during ETH Denver.
body: With Enigma Bazaar, Burrito made a meeting place for artists during ETH Denver. The gathering brought digital art into a local space and gave people a chance to talk about where the medium was going.

title: Think Less, Vibe More
subtitle: Our first sponsored event
summary: An early Burrito gathering built around being present with art and with each other.
body: Think Less, Vibe More marked Burrito’s first event sponsorship. An evening in Miami with a simple invitation: spend time with the art, meet people, and enjoy being in the room.
